publishedMetadata.title: Optimistic updates and rollback
publishedMetadata.description: An applied TanStack Query 5 module on optimistic updates and rollback, integrating real HTTP, cache state, failure recovery, and separate instructor/browser acceptance.
objectives: Snapshot affected query data before an optimistic delete, roll back on failure, and reconcile after the mutation settles.
Force DELETE 404 or transport failure. The cached row must be restored. Success must invalidate server data. Disable concurrent deletes or implement version-aware compensation.
Snapshot rollback only remains correct when conflicting updates are serialized or reconciled; overlapping optimistic mutations need a more careful policy.
